prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a can of "Géant Vert" (Green Giant) vegetables, prominently displayed in the foreground and sharply in focus, with several other similar cans softly blurred in the background, creating a shallow depth of field. The can features a distinctive label with a green, muscular figure reminiscent of a classical statue, standing confidently with hands on hips, and bold yellow and purple text reading "Ma Récolte" and "Jean-Michel Davault." The lighting is warm and slightly diffuse, casting gentle highlights and reflections on the metallic surfaces of the cans, evoking a cozy, inviting atmosphere. The background is softly lit, with hints of industrial shelving or a production line, suggesting a factory or warehouse setting. The overall color palette is dominated by earthy greens, muted metallic grays, and warm golden tones, contributing to a nostalgic, slightly cinematic feel. The composition draws the viewer’s eye directly to the central can, emphasizing its branding and design, while the out-of-focus repetition of cans in the background adds depth and context to the scene.
